confidence_notes: Citywide data support the meal, cappuccino and draft beer estimates. Cocktail and house wine estimates use local price ranges relative to draft beer. July lodging is modeled and varies by week and neighborhood. [Numbeo restaurant data](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Split), [Retro Tuk Split drink prices](https://retrotuksplit.com/travel-guide/split-prices-cost-guide)
comparable_city_reasoning: Zadar and Šibenik are qualitative comparisons for peak-season lodging demand on the Dalmatian coast. The estimates account for demand around Split's old town and ferry port.
